page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.u2a server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz.

This server is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, this instance offers a stable performance profile for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for application servers, web serving, microservices, and development environments that require consistent CPU performance without the burstable limitations of shared-core instances.
